summary.value: Arthouse Hotel is a character-filled Boutique Hotel on the Upper West Side whose guests praise a safe, pleasant neighborhood, big comfortable rooms and good food steps away. The trade-offs come up just as often: lobby music can run loud, room sizes and upkeep vary, and dining nearby adds to the bill.

description.value: Arthouse Hotel is a Boutique Hotel on the Upper West Side, and the hotel says our century-old building retains many of its historic accents. Rooms start at approximately 240 square feet, there are three on-site restaurants and bars, and the Natural History Museum sits a mere two blocks away from our property. Tripadvisor rates it 4.2 Good (8,181) and its summary finds it favorably located near Central Park and the subway. Honest watch-outs from the same summary: guests flag the music too loud, experiences with housekeeping and room size vary, and some travelers feel the hotel is overpriced with limited amenities.

review1: Guests like the Arthouse's location, describing a safe, pleasant residential area that still feels connected to the rest of Manhattan.
review2: Rooms are generally described as roomy by city standards, with comfortable beds and good cleanliness that make longer stays feel relaxed.
review3: Dining nearby is a plus, with well-regarded restaurants right next to the hotel, though guests warn that eating there adds noticeably to the cost of the trip.
review4: The main watch-out is that the public areas feel freshly renovated while some guest rooms still look clearly dated, so expectations for the room decor should be modest.
